Name: (CP) Poultry House Product Price Adjustment
Author: LunaGlaze
Description:
Have you ever wondered why even if the poultry house is upgraded to its maximum size, the animals that can only be obtained after removing perfection are still the most profitable for the original chickens?
你是否想过，为什么禽舍即使升级到最大，除去完美之后才能获得的动物也是最初始的鸡能获取最大的收益？
After adding this mod, everything is different!
当你添加了这个mod之后，一切都不一样了！
[list]
[*]Dinosaur Egg (恐龙蛋): 350 →1050 (×3)
[*]Dinosaur Mayonnaise (恐龙蛋黄酱): 800→2400 (×3)
[*]Void Egg (虚空蛋): 65→130 (×2)
[*]Void Mayonnaise (虚空蛋黄酱): 275→550 (×2)
[*]Rabbit's Foot (兔子的脚): 565→850 (≈×1.5)
[*]Duck Feather (鸭毛): 250→325 (×1.3)
[*]Duck Egg (鸭蛋): 95→105 (≈×1.1)
[*]Duck Mayonnaise (鸭蛋黄酱): 375→400 (≈×1.07)
[/list]_________________________________________________________________________
